subject: expression: support push-down INTDIV to TiKV (#49051)
summary: Adds `ast.IntDiv` to TiKV pushdown allowlist and updates PB conversion tests to validate INTDIV pushdown. Adjusts MOD (and INTDIV-int) scalar/vector evaluation to avoid division-by-zero handling when any operand is NULL and to keep behavior consistent across execution paths. Improves PB decimal constant decoding by preserving the protobuf FieldType for `ExprType_MysqlDecimal` constants; no later upstream changes found suggesting follow-up fixes were required.
